subject: Surge account stewardship and remediation brief
messages:
From: Sarah Linton <sarah.linton@aurora-retail.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com; support@redwood.com
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: High request error rate + throughput spike impacting checkout (Aurora)

Hi Rishi / Redwood team,

We saw a sustained spike in 5xx errors and token-level latency across our checkout flows starting ~07:08 PDT this morning. Site rate-limited for several customers and our throughput fell off despite retry logic. We raised a Pager and our SREs captured traces — attaching a short summary (ops included).

Key impact:
- ~22% increase in per-request latency (p90 up from 420ms to ~510ms)
- 4.8% of requests returned 500/502 during the spike window (07:08–07:39)
- Autoscaling on our side did not prevent user-facing errors for ~25 minutes

Can you provide an initial triage and ETA for a root-cause writeup? This is customer-critical; our execs are on call.

Attachments: ops-summary-0730.txt (log snippets)

Thanks,
Sarah Linton
Director, Platform Reliability
Aurora Retail

From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
To: Sarah Linton <sarah.linton@aurora-retail.com>
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.com; karthik.iyer@redwood.com; hiro.tanaka@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 09:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: High request error rate + throughput spike impacting checkout (Aurora)

Hi Sarah — thanks for the heads up and the logs. We're in triage now. Initial points:
- I'm spinning up a dedicated bridge between Aurora SRE and our incident team.
- Grace will own preliminary RCA collection; Hiro will check serving runtime telemetry and kernel selection logs; Karthik will pull routing/batching policy traces.
- I'll provide an interim summary within 90 minutes and an RCA draft by EOD PDT.

Can you confirm whether Aurora was using any custom routing policy or pinned model during the window? Also please share any client-side retry patterns you observed.

We will attach any debug dumps we collect.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com; karthik.iyer@redwood.com; hiro.tanaka@redwood.com
Cc: Sarah Linton <sarah.linton@aurora-retail.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: High request error rate + throughput spike impacting checkout (Aurora)

On Mon, Jul 30, 2028 at 9:26 AM rishi.malhotra@redwood.com wrote:
> Hi Sarah — thanks for the heads up and the logs. We're in triage now.

Quick technical note from triage:
- We correlated the timestamps to our influx of short-lived large-batch requests from a scheduled Aurora job (approx 07:07–07:12). Those batches caused unusual KV cache churn on the shards serving Aurora, which in turn increased tail latency and triggered transient 502s from retry saturation.
- We saw a config mismatch on the autoscaler that delayed GPU pool expansion by ~3 minutes (scaling cooldown still at 180s rather than 30s for that policy).
- No evidence of model corruption or kernel failure; model variants were serving correctly.

I attached a debug dump (aurora_debug_dump_0730.tar.gz) with service traces and a CSV of metric peaks. Initial remediation steps we've already applied:
1) temporarily throttled the scheduled batch job at Aurora's request (they confirmed pause)
2) adjusted autoscaler cooldown to 30s for the affected pool (temporary override)
3) enabled a routing bypass to move Aurora traffic to a warm pool with more KV cache locality.

I'll compile the above into a short RCA draft and circulate.

Grace O'Connor
Director, Incident Response
Redwood Inference
Attachments: aurora_debug_dump_0730.tar.gz; metric-summaries-0730.csv

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com; grace.oconnor@redwood.com; hiro.tanaka@redwood.com
Cc: Sarah Linton <sarah.linton@aurora-retail.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 12:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: High request error rate + throughput spike impacting checkout (Aurora)

Adding the operational impact and planned owner list for follow-through:
- Short term (today, <24h):
  * Karthik - validate autoscaler policy, run a replay against warm pool to check KV cache rehydration time, confirm rollout of cooldown override and document change.
  * Grace - finalize RCA draft and share with Aurora SRE by EOD.
  * Hiro - create telemetry snapshots and confirm there are no lingering memory leaks in the runtime.
- Medium term (1–2 weeks):
  * Engineering: create an autoscaler policy test in CI for cooldown guardrails.
  * Product/Platform: add a routing policy that avoids co-locating large scheduled batch jobs with low-latency customer traffic.
- Exec communication: Rishi to lead a short update for Aurora execs at 16:30 PDT.

I've opened JIRA-INC-4521 to track the engineering work. I'll link the ticket in the RCA.

— Karthik
Principal SRE
Redwood Inference

From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
To: Sarah Linton <sarah.linton@aurora-retail.com>; ops@aurora-retail.com
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.com; karthik.iyer@redwood.com; hiro.tanaka@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 31 Jul 2028 00:45:00 -0700
Subject: Final RCA and remediation commitments (Aurora throughput/lower availability)

Sarah — attaching the RCA draft and the initial remediation plan we discussed on the bridge. Summary below for your exec team.

Executive summary:
- Root cause: simultaneous scheduled large-batch traffic from Aurora induced KV cache churn on the serving shards; an autoscaler cooldown misconfiguration delayed pool expansion; combined effect increased tail latency and transient 5xx responses.
- Actions completed: temporary throttling of batch job; autoscaler cooldown override applied; routing bypass to warm pool.
- Committed follow-ups and owners: see condensed table below (full action list in attached PDF).

Condensed follow-ups:
- "Autoscaler CI guardrail" — owner: karthik. Target: 2028-08-07.
- "Routing policy: batch isolation" — owner: product/platform team (sprint Q3).
- "KV cache instrumentation" — owner: hiro.tanaka. Target: 2028-08-04.
- "Customer-facing postmortem" — owner: rishi.malhotra. Target: 2028-08-02 (final signed).

Attachments: postmortem-draft-20280731.pdf (RCA + timeline + attachments).

Please confirm if the remediation timeline looks acceptable. We'll track progress in JIRA-INC-4521 and schedule a follow-up on 2028-08-02 to close outstanding items.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Linton <sarah.linton@aurora-retail.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.com; karthik.iyer@redwood.com; hiro.tanaka@redwood.com; ops@aurora-retail.com
Date: Thu, 2 Aug 2028 18:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final RCA and remediation commitments (Aurora throughput/lower availability)

Rishi / team — thanks for the quick triage and a clear remediation plan. Aurora execs reviewed the RCA and asked that we prioritize the autoscaler CI guardrail and the routing isolation work. The timelines look achievable — we accept them with one ask: can Redwood provide a weekly status note in JIRA-INC-4521 until the autoscaler guardrail is merged?

We paused the scheduled batch jobs for this month and will coordinate testing windows with your team. Otherwise looks good — appreciate the rapid response.

Regards,
Sarah Linton
Director, Platform Reliability
Aurora Retail
